correctness.rationale: Exact Mellin moments give Li_{-s}(t)/t. Eulerian recurrence plus reciprocal symmetry give m-1 inner simple negative roots, one simple -1 root and m-1 outer roots at s=2m. Uniform Jonquière expansion excludes any escaping roots near t=1; analytic continuity and Rouché exclude other roots in the rest of the disk. The implicit-function theorem and eta/zeta functional equation give positive odd-zeta crossing velocity, verified independently at m=1..6 with actual checker.py. All parameter-domain and boundary quantifiers stated explicitly.

value.rationale: The weight is a canonical radial Mellin log-moment model with explicit monomial norms and natural Bergman kernel. Determining precisely when reproducing kernels gain a zero is a motivated Lu Qi-Keng invariant. The theorem produces a nontrivial, infinite ordered family of local real-parameter transitions, rules out hidden complex disk zeros, and quantifies speeds by odd zeta ratios; unlike routine polynomial substitution, it requires uniform noninteger-order boundary control. No global classification or downstream theorem is asserted.
